name: gplike
expr: [nL_kpos, ac_kpos] = gplike([0.5, 1], x); [nL_k0, ac_k0] = gplike([0, 1], x); nL_xneg = gplike([0.5, 1], xneg); nL_oos = gplike([-1, 1], 10); nL_sigbad = gplike([0.5, -1], x);
comment: Sig: [nL, acov] = gplike([k sigma], x). GP NLL with implicit theta=0. acov is the 2×2 inverse observed-Fisher matrix at [k, sigma], computed via central-difference Hessian (tol=1e-5 reflects FD precision; k=0 stride is the worst case at ~2e-6). Edges: sigma<=0 or per-point support violation (1+k*x/sigma<=0) => NaN. MATLAB does NOT enforce x>=0 globally — only the per-point support check; numkit matches (e.g. gplike([0.5,1], [-1 1 2]') returns 1.2163...).
